title: Improve direct fetch content negotiation
description: Add text/markdown preference and accurate output format/extraction metadata while retaining bounded plain text, JSON/XML, HTML Readability/Turndown, PDF, YouTube, cancellation, SSRF, and untrusted-content behavior. No browser fallback or cache.

logs.msg: Implemented Markdown content negotiation and extraction: direct transport now prefers text/markdown, the worker preserves text/markdown and text/x-markdown as bounded untrusted Markdown, and output metadata reports extraction=markdown. Added offline transport/fetch fixtures. bun run check passes: 112 tests, 258 assertions.
